title: Meta's AI Now Does the Work. Who's in Control?
description:
Meta's Muse can work across connected business apps. What should you check before letting an AI agent act?

This AI This Week episode follows one shop, one customer question, and one crucial approval step. Based on Meta's 29 September 2026 Muse for Small Business announcement, from the week of 28 September–4 October.

CHAPTERS
00:00 The approval pause
00:26 One owner, too many tabs
00:48 From answers to actions
01:00 An illustrative delivery workflow
01:32 Preparation is not permission
01:43 One wrong date
02:03 Access and safeguards
02:26 A small practical test
02:38 Availability and your trust line
03:01 What to watch next

The interfaces, order and mistake are illustrative animations, not product recordings or a hands-on test. Capabilities and safeguards are Meta's claims; availability and access can vary. Narration uses a synthetic voice. Stock footage: Antoni Shkraba / Pexels.

Would you let an AI draft, send, or spend? Tell us where your line is.
